scope: ONE attempt at A = Re(f^H M^-1 f)/L on N2R's constrained Nedelec space. No coupling extraction, no E_C, no g, no second level, no retry.

image_source.note: image_id and image_archive_sha256 are DIFFERENT identifiers; no registry digest exists, the image was never pushed

execution.dof_note: an expectation from the N2R baseline, NOT a substitute for measuring and enforcing the cap on the actual run
execution.no_retry: a timeout, a DOF refusal or a nonzero exit is the recorded outcome; the attempt is spent either way
execution.no_oversubscribe: the synthetic fixtures' launcher option is not used here and is not authorised for this run

one_attempt.why_run_number_1: the workflow is new, so its first dispatch is run number 1. If run 1 is consumed without launching - an infrastructure failure, a cancelled job - this approval is spent and a fresh one naming run 2 is required.
one_attempt.not_bound: the commit, because this file is part of the commit it would have to name; the reviewed state is bound by the digests above instead
